div.div: This ensures a deterministic length of the final scheduled task and sets a user configurable timeout equal to the expected length between now and the first task running in the next scheduler window.

div.div: This ensures that each scheduled task has a fixed execution time equal to the defined timeout, since it waits until the Synchronous Watchdog can be cleared before calling the next task. This makes it easer to synchronize the schedule with the FDTI and Watchdog.

div.div: Responsible for clearing the Watchdog and performing the WDT Counter diagnostic. This is done by sampling the counter before and after the clear. The before-sample is compared to the previous after-sample to ensure that the value was changed. This additionally ensures the diagnostic is performed within FDTI. The first clear ensures that windowed mode starts after running the Startup Task Manager.
